caption: The drawing depicts a single rectangular wooden table with a light brown color, showcasing wood grain patterns throughout its surface, legs, and drawer. The table has four straight, tapered legs extending from each corner. In the center of the front-facing side, there is a single rectangular drawer with a black metal handle ring attached to it. The drawer is slightly outlined, and the handle appears to be fixed in the middle of the drawer front. The table top is flat and slightly extends beyond the frame of the legs and sides. The background is plain and white, with scattered small brownish spots around the figure, but no other objects or elements are present in the composition.
title: Baker's Table
